biotools.summary: BioFlow-Insight is a Python command-line tool that analyzes Nextflow workflow code to generate visual graphs and a RO-Crate JSON-LD file describing the workflow’s structure. It facilitates workflow inspection and reuse by providing insights into the workflow's components and dependencies.
